metadata.title: k-grosser/requirementsclassification: Replication Package for REFSQ'25 Submission
metadata.description: This repository contains data and code related to experimentation on the automated classification of requirements from standards into five classes relevant for the integration step of standard tailoring (functional (F), non-functional (NF), project management (PM), meta (M), and view (V)). Five common machine learning algorithms (k-Nearest Neighbor (kNN), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Logistic Regression (LR), Multinomial Naive Bayes (MNB), Random Forest (RF)) as well as an ensemble model combining all five are compared with respect to their performance and the impact of term context integration is evaluated.

metadata.title: RepoScope: A Multi-Granularity Query-by-Example Framework for Github Repository Search
metadata.description:
This repository contains the replication package for RepoScope. 

The package includes: 

  • reposcope_pipeline.ipynb: Contains the code and step-by-step procedures used in the RepoScope study, specifically implementing Repository Embedding and Retrieval and Clustering and Visualization steps of RepoScope. 

  • all_repos.json: Includes a list of 7143 repository information with their metadata necessary for executing the code in the Jupyter Notebook.

Requirements: 

  • The notebook includes a list of libraries that need to be installed for the code to run properly. 

  • Accessing certain models may require a Hugging Face API token before running the code.

hits.title: RepoScope: A Multi-Granularity Query-by-Example Framework for Github Repository Search

metadata.title: Pipelines Under Pressure: Analyzing GitHub CI/CD Workflows for Possible Misconfigurations
metadata.description:
Replication package for MSR submission #65 - Pipelines Under Pressure: Analyzing GitHub CI/CD Workflows for Possible Misconfigurations

The files contained in this replication package are:

  1. workflows_auxiliaries_groups.csv.zip - This file contains the metadata used to build the Repository objects, where each row corresponds to one workflow;
  2. yaml_workflows.zip - This file contains all the raw YAML workflow files;
  3. json_repos.zip - This file contains the parsed JSON repositories;
  4. under_pressure.zip - This file contains the scripts used to compute the results and generate the plots reported in the paper.

The metadata contains the following columns:

  1. repository - The name of the repository in which the workflow was found;
  2. file_path - The path of the workflow file as found in its repository;
  3. file_hash - The filename of the workflow as found in the other zip file of this replication package;
  4. authored_date - The date in which the commit was authored.

hits.title: Pipelines Under Pressure: Analyzing GitHub CI/CD Workflows for Possible Misconfigurations

metadata.title: BlackCAT: A Malicious Maven Packages Detector based on Static Analysis and Graph Learning
metadata.description:
This is the replication package of paper of "BlackCAT: A Malicious Maven Packages Detector based on
Static Analysis and Graph Learning".

Usage

static_analysis_module: In the Tai-e folder, use the command ./run.sh.  Please note that the path to the dataset file is required; additionally, it is necessary to create a Java project and provide the classpath for a .class file containing a main method.

detection_model_module: Utilize fix_dot_error.py to preprocess the dot files generated by the static_analysis_module, employ get_embedding.py to generate embedding representations for the statements, and apply training.py for model training and the detection of malicious packages.

hits.title: BlackCAT: A Malicious Maven Packages Detector based on Static Analysis and Graph Learning
